score_contract.score_semantics: basewise evolutionary conservation/acceleration score; positive values indicate conservation and negative values indicate faster evolution

provenance.notes: The official UCSC hg38 phyloP100way REST track was qualified for all 946 locked coordinates with 946/946 HTTP_OK observations and no missing values. The returned value is a site-wise conservation/acceleration score at the reference coordinate, not an alternate-minus-reference sequence score; it remains a separately labeled public comparator and is not an apples-to-apples foundation-model result. Evidence: artifacts/phase6a/comparators/phylop100way_hg38_20260921.json and artifacts/phase6a/phase6a_comparator_qualification_20260921.json.
